identitySignals: Name matches a registered Oakland nonprofit: 'Roots Community Health Center' (GuideStar and ProPublica, EIN 26-2583954, Oakland, CA); the agenda's 'Roots Community Health Clinic' is a variant of the same name

OUSD's own news page says Roots Community Health is a primary tenant at the former Parker School campus (Parker Community Resource Center), matching the agenda's use agreements for a portion of former Parker School
Search results show Roots operating programs at the Parker Campus, 7929 Ney Ave, Oakland
research.notes: The organization's own website blocks automated fetching (HTTP 403 Cloudflare), so phone, email and street address were not captured. The website URL comes from search results; GuideStar lists an older domain, rootsclinic.org. Cal SOS entity number and SAM UEI not looked up.

profile.summary: Roots Community Health Center is an Oakland-based nonprofit health center. It provides medical care, behavioral health services, health navigation, workforce development, housing support, outreach and advocacy, with a stated aim of helping people affected by systemic inequities and poverty. It operates fixed and mobile clinics.

sources.title: Roots Community Health Center - Nonprofit Explorer - ProPublica

review.notes: GuideStar and ProPublica confirm Roots Community Health Center, EIN 26-2583954, Oakland 501(c)(3) health center, matching the agenda's Parker School use agreements (an Oakland health nonprofit as facility tenant); the 'fixed and mobile clinics' phrase and website URL could not be fetched (site returns 403) but are consistent with the listing and the identity is not in doubt.
